messages:
lee: Heads-up — AcmePay opened a support escalation. After last night's model rollout (v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0) they see large output-quality regressions, but only for requests routed to APAC H100 clusters (ap-sg-1, ap-sg-2). No HTTP errors (200 OK). They provided request_ids and sample payloads.

ops-bot: deploy finished: rw-infer/v3.3.0 -> ap-sg-1, ap-sg-2 at 2026-02-26T03:12:14Z :rocket: (link)

sam: Can you paste one of the request_ids + the exact curl you used? Also which model alias was used in the API call?

lee: Provided below. Customer is calling model alias `rw-instruct-3.3.0`. Request ids: `rq_20260226_ak9f2`, `rq_20260226_bm3x7`. Repro curl:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3.3.0","input":"Summarize the following billing policy for enterprise customers: [long policy text]","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0}'
```

Expected: concise, factual summary. Actual (APAC/H100): garbled/truncated and occasionally returns boilerplate apology text even though prompt was straightforward. Example response snippet from `rq_20260226_ak9f2`:

```json
{"id":"rq_20260226_ak9f2","status":200,"output":"\nSummary:\nI am sorry, I cannot provide that.====\u0000\u0000\u0000\n"}
```

lee: Note — same request routed to eu-west-1 (A100) returns correct summary for the same model alias and same customer prompt. So far appears region+hardware-specific.

nina: Thanks. Eng-ML: we shipped a small kernel selection tweak last week to improve perf on models with long prefix KV caching. That tweak landed in v3.3.0 runtime and was rolled to APAC H100 pools first (canary -> all). Might be related. Can you capture a payload that reproduces the garbling end-to-end (we need raw token logits if possible)?

michael: Eng-runtime: I see a small divergence in softmax scaling for sequences > 512 after the kernel change on H100. On host-level traces there are a few fused op reorderings that differ from A100 path. Could cause different token probabilities and weird stop sequences. We need deterministic repro.

lee: Customer attached a minimal prompt that reproduces in ~3/10 runs on ap-sg-1. Repro steps (from their environment):

1) POST call (curl above) using `rw-instruct-3.3.0` alias
2) set `max_tokens` 256 and `temperature` 0.0
3) repeat 5 times — failure appears nondeterministic but biased towards APAC pool

Sample failing output they copied (raw):

```
Summary:
I am sorry, I cannot provide that.\u0000\u0000\u0000
```

Sample succeeding output (eu-west):

```
Summary:
Enterprise customers are billed monthly; discounts apply for annual contracts... [concise bullets]
```

anya: From SRE side — production telemetry shows a subtle uptick in `bad_output_rate` for ap-sg clusters since 03:10 UTC when v3.3.0 reached canary. p95 latency up 5%. No increase in HTTP 5xx. I'll pin routing for AcmePay to eu-west-1 as a temporary mitigant.

sam: For customer workaround: can we 1) pin their traffic to older runtime/model, or 2) route them to eu region? Which is faster?

nina: Easiest fast workaround is routing (change region override) — no model rollback needed and lower blast radius. We can also create a model alias pointing to v3.2.1 and assign it to the customer as a hotfix. We'll triage kernel change separately.

lee: I've asked AcmePay if routing to eu-west-1 is acceptable; they agreed to test. I'll hold other customers off until we have a root cause.

michael: Action items for eng-runtime: capture `TRACE_INFER=1` logs for `rq_20260226_*` on ap-sg-1, dump raw logits and apply the same quantization path on a local H100 box. Also collect driver version `nvcc` and CUDA minor versions — we saw differing behavior between CUDA 12.3 and 12.4 with the new fused kernels.

nina: Repro command for eng-runtime: run behind the same serving binary with `REDWOOD_KERNEL_PROFILE=legacy` to force old kernel selection and compare outputs. Example debug run: 

```bash
REDWOOD_KEY=debug-key \ 
REDWOOD_KERNEL_PROFILE=legacy \ 
TRACE_INFER=1 \ 
./rw_infer_server --model-path /mnt/models/rw-instruct-3.3.0 --listen 127.0.0.1:5050 \ 
# then curl localhost:5050/generate with same payload from above
```

nina: If forcing legacy kernel fixes the output, we have a strong signal the new kernel reorder is the culprit.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate created: rw-infer/v3.3.0-kernel-rollback -> ap-sg-1 (canary). Action: eng-runtime should approve canary rollback.

sam: Eng-runtime please approve canary rollback and capture the failing trace during the canary so we can compare. I'll own communication thread with AcmePay.

anya: SRE note — raised incident priority to P2 to track customer SLA impact. Logging retention increased for ap-sg-1/2 for next 72h.

lee: AcmePay tested eu-west routing and confirmed summaries look good again. They've accepted the temporary routing while we investigate. They'll want a timeline for permanent fix and are asking about credits.

michael: I'll coordinate kernel revert and a targeted A/B test across GPU variants. If revert restores outputs we schedule a patch for the kernel selection logic and a follow-up rollout with extra canaries (single-customer canary in APAC).

lee: Thanks all. I'll update the customer and paste any further failing request_ids here. :thumbsup:
